fixtures.source: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH='/var/folders/b6/2r9mrtsj70s3x013xbhxt2yr0000gn/T/acme-style-engines-fHTyxk/browsers';const pw=await import('/var/folders/b6/2r9mrtsj70s3x013xbhxt2yr0000gn/T/acme-style-engines-fHTyxk/package/index.mjs');const results=[];for(const engine of ['chromium','firefox','webkit']){const browser=await pw[engine].launch(engine==='chromium'?{executablePath:'/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome',headless:true}:{headless:true});try{const page=await browser.newPage();const data=await page.evaluate(async()=>{class NativeProbe extends HTMLElement{static formAssociated=true;internals=this.attachInternals();}customElements.define('native-label-probe',NativeProbe);const host=document.createElement('native-label-probe') as NativeProbe;host.id='target';const label=document.createElement('label');label.id='first';label.htmlFor='target';document.body.append(label,host);const read=()=>[...host.internals.labels].map(label=>({id:label.id,for:(label as HTMLLabelElement).htmlFor,control:(label as HTMLLabelElement).control?.id}));const first=read();label.htmlFor='other';await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));const changed=read();const second=document.createElement('label');second.id='second';second.htmlFor='target';document.body.append(second);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));return{first,changed,added:read()};});results.push({engine,...data});}finally{await browser.close();}}console.log(JSON.stringify(results,null,2));await Bun.write('/tmp/acme-m10-checkbox/native-label-results.json',JSON.stringify(results,null,2)+'\n');

limits: Happy DOM has no ElementInternals; the test-only adapter is not evidence of native form behavior. Native browser fixtures are authoritative.

Native Firefox ElementInternals.labels retains a stale label after its for changes, reproduced without Lit or house code. Name delegation filters candidates using native label.control. Public labels still exposes the platform collection.
Browser history/autofill restoration remains a real-browser final gate; explicit callback checks do not establish it.
Checkbox Group/cards, Radio/groups/cards, Switch, Segmented Control, Tabs, shared indicator and Theme Switcher remain M10.
